name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention exactly. The trailing 22 is a chapter ID (chapters 1-30 are meaningful domain IDs per fd2-knowledge: '第22章 遠古呼喚'), confirmed by the dispatch-table index (chapter ID = index + 1) and the linked end/post-action handlers, not a Ghidra address residue. Name accurately reflects the per-chapter init-handler role.
purpose: Chapter 22 (遠古呼喚) init handler: a minimal flat chapter-prologue orchestrator dispatched via the chapter init-handler table (no direct callers).
logic_summary: Re-inits battle state, pans camera-and-window once to (0x10,0x1C), triggers cutscene event 0x43, clears all char facings, plays exactly one dialog page (page 0) via fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, 0, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1), then pans the camera to char 0. No portrait load and no char init -- chapter 22 carries the party over from the previous chapter; battle_anim_phase is never reset on this path. In the binary the function physically holds only its entry block plus PUSH 0x43, then tail-JMPs 0x3369B -> 0x33440 into the shared body owned by fd2_chapter_12_init (cutscene CALL -> clear-facing -> shared page-0 dialog chain 0x3344D -> 0x33206 -> 0x33140 pan+RET). The straight-line C is the functionally-equivalent Layer-2 reconstruction. Leading __CHK(0x28) is the Watcom frame-size stack probe, not part of the source body.

returns.semantics: No return value; orchestrates the chapter-22 prologue sequence for side effects.

comment_original_issue: The original comment was accurate and detailed but referenced the post-action handler by a stale name (fd2_chapter_22_post_action) instead of its current live Ghidra name (fd2_chapter_22_27_28_post_action_shared @ 0x20A87), and contained two non-ASCII em-dashes within the comment block.
